corrections: Deadline ownership now uses an exact nonzero {registrationId, armSequence} token whose sequence is assigned globally by the scheduler. Every accepted replacement receives a unique returned token, and cancellation removes only the exact live arm, so an expired arm or delayed cancel cannot affect its successor even after dequeue.
Handler and deadline worker closures retain shared implementation ownership. A completion callback may release the outer owner without invalidating the running worker state or self-joining.
Every off-worker deadline shutdown call waits on the shared worker-exit barrier even when another caller claimed the thread handle; a worker-reentrant shutdown never waits on itself.
Adapter shutdown is documented as a composition-order close and drain boundary, not permission to destroy an adapter under an active member call.
